problem: The company wanted to limit commercial competitors using its code.
title: HashiCorp moves Terraform and other tools to the Business Source License
context: Terraform, Vault, Consul and other HashiCorp tools were licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.
decision_made: Switch future releases to the Business Source License 1.1.
observed_outcome: The community forked Terraform as OpenTofu, accepted by the Linux Foundation in September 2023. One analyst found little evidence of significant business harm to HashiCorp.
lessons: Relicensing can trigger a community fork even when the business effect is small.
limitations: IBM completed its acquisition of HashiCorp in February 2025, which complicates reading the later results. Business impact is based on commentary, not company data.

claims.claim_text: HashiCorp moved Terraform and its other core tools to the Business Source License.
The community created the OpenTofu fork, which became a Linux Foundation project.
